alex: Heads up: NVD just published a CVE affecting sentencepiece v0.1.96 and protobuf <3.20 that can lead to out-of-bounds in serializer. Vendor notes exploit chain possible when native kernels (FlashAttention/Triton ops) process untrusted model shards. Affects hosted + Dedicated runtime images. Need triage + patch plan. @maria @jordan
maria: Adding detail: vuln triggers during vocab/deserialization + proto parsing. Exploit requires a crafted model file; risk medium for public hosted, higher for Dedicated/private where customers upload models.
jordan: Can we mitigate by disabling native kernels or forcing safe CPU fallback until patched? Also what about KMS/audit for model uploads — we need telemetry to detect exploit attempts.
alex: Agreed. Immediate mitigations: 1) block untrusted model uploads via allowlist, 2) enable model-validation job in pipeline, 3) runtime flag to disable native kernels: `--runtime.disable_native_kernels=true`. Patch path: bump sentencepiece to 0.1.97 and protobuf to 3.20.3 in wheel/base image and rebuild runtime images.
sam: Created GH issue: github.com/redwood/inference/infra/issues/3421 and started a draft PR to update base-image and wheels. ETA for staging build ~2h. @deploy-bot can we schedule a 10% canary?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary for `inference-runtime:pr-3421` to staging (10% traffic) at 2026-02-15T17:40:00Z
maria: RBAC change needed: temporarily restrict model-upload API to an allowlist of orgs until the patch lands. That touches Console + API gateway policy. @li can you advise fastest route?
li: I can push a temporary policy: `deny: uploads where org.role != \"trusted\"`. Will open a change and tag sec-review. Also increasing audit-log retention for model-upload events + enable more verbose KMS event logging.
jordan: Also need to confirm envelope encryption: are customer model artifacts always wrapped with KMS keys on upload? If not, we need notices and key rotation guidance.
alex: Prioritization: P1 for Dedicated/private with user-uploaded models; P2 for hosted default. Plan: hotpatch Dedicated tonight 22:00 UTC (force patch + kernel-disable flag), then staged hosted rollout tomorrow morning with canary. Any objections?
sam: No objections. I'll coordinate oncall shifts and runbooks.
maria: I'll draft a short customer advisory — keep it generic (vulnerability in third-party lib affecting model ingestion), avoid exploit details. Coordinate with comms.
security-bot: security-bot: CVE assigned CVE-2026-1887 (placeholder), initial CVSS 7.8. Created ticket SEC-2026-87 and linked infra issue.
alex: Add tests: fuzz sentencepiece loader with malformed inputs and add integration test for image validation pipeline. Also include probe to detect unusual upload rates.
li: RBAC PR: https://github.com/redwood/policies/pull/120 opened, set to "in review" and tagged `sec-review`.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging canary for `inference-runtime:pr-3421` completed — 10% traffic for 30m, no errors observed, no crashes.
jordan: After patch lands we should run a performance regression suite on 50 representative models; forcing fallback may change latency/cost. Schedule perf run in CI and sample prod sims.
maria: I'll own customer comms and compliance artifacts — will log KMS and RBAC changes for SOC2 evidence and add notes to the change control.
alex: OK. Reconvene in #eng-oncall 30m after staging canary to decide Dedicated hotpatch window. Post any blockers here.
